title: tephroseris integrifolia var. leiocarpa
intro: Tephroseris integrifolia var. leiocarpa, commonly known as Korean Mountain Leontopodium, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and other respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Korean Mountain Leontopodium are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
